# coval_scheduled_run (Data Source)

Retrieves a Coval scheduled run by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coval_scheduled_run" "nightly" {
  id = "xyz789uvw456rst123abcd"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Scheduled-run ID.

### Optional

- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace ID that scopes this lookup. Omit it to use the organization's active default workspace.

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `last_run_at` (String)
- `last_run_id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `run_template_id` (String)
- `schedule_expression` (String)
- `schedule_timezone` (String)
- `update_time` (String)
